content:
[global]
   workgroup = WORKGROUP
   server string = Deb-Dev-Builder
   server role = standalone server
   security = user
   map to guest = Bad User
   obey pam restrictions = yes
   unix extensions = yes
   min protocol = SMB2
   mdns name = mdns
   load printers = no
   printing = cups

[homes]
   comment = Home Directories
   browseable = no
   read only = no
   valid users = %S
